summary: AEye, Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market (ATM) equity program under which it may sell up to $50.0 million of common stock from time to time through sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, pursuant to a sales agreement dated September 15, 2026. A.G.P. acts on a commercially reasonable efforts basis for a commission of up to 3.0% of gross proceeds, with no escrow and no minimum sale requirement; the prior September 12, 2024 ATM agreement was terminated concurrently. AEye's stock (Nasdaq: LIDR) last traded at $1.23 on September 14, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
